title: Start here: what Mizaj is
caption:
Welcome to Mizaj, a personality test for desis everywhere.

Two old ideas, one card: your type (16 of them: how you think and decide) and your element (Air, Fire, Water or Earth: how you run). 16 × 4 = 64 cards, and one of them is uncomfortably you.

Here you'll find each type in the group chat, element versus element, Field Notes on a 2,000-year-old idea, and compatibility posts for your family and friends.

Send this to the friend who still hasn't found their type.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
